prompt.description: Text description of the required image. The GPT image model supports up to 32,000 characters, `dall-e-2` supports up to 1,000 characters, and `dall-e-3` supports up to 4,000 characters. A selection of example prompts is provided in the dropdown list (source: [EvoLinkAI/awesome-gpt-image-2-prompts](https://github.com/EvoLinkAI/awesome-gpt-image-2-prompts), Apache-2.0 license); you can also enter your own.

model.description: Models for image generation. Supports OpenAI’s `dall-e-2`, `dall-e-3`, `gpt-image-1` / `gpt-image-1.5` / `gpt-image-2` / `gpt-image-2.5-flare` / `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` series, as well as Google’s `nano-banana` / `nano-banana-2-lite` / `nano-banana-2` / `nano-banana-2.1` / `nano-banana-pro`. The `size`, `quality`, `style`, `background`, `output_format`, `moderation`, and `response_format` parameters supported by different models vary; see the description of each field for details. `gpt-image-2` provides `gpt-image-2:official` (official channel, stable and compliant, billed based on the actual Token usage of text input and image output) and `gpt-image-2:reverse` (equivalent to the default `gpt-image-2`, with better cost performance); `gpt-image-2.5-flare` and `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` also respectively provide same-named `:official` variants, billed based on actual Token usage. GPT Image 2.6 supports `gpt-image-2.6-flare`, `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`, and their respective `:reverse` and `:official` variants; the standard version and `:reverse` cost 0.22 Credits/image, while `:official` is the same as 2.5 and billed based on actual Token usage.

size.description: The size of the generated image, in the format `widthxheight`, or fill in `auto` to select the canvas based on the prompt semantics. **The GPT Image 2 series (`gpt-image-2`, `gpt-image-2.5-flare`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, `gpt-image-2.6-flare`, `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst`)** accepts any `WIDTHxHEIGHT` value that conforms to the format, including 1K presets (`1024x1024`, `1536x1024`, `1024x1536`, `1792x1024`, `1024x1792`), 2K presets (`2048x2048`, `2048x1536`, `1536x2048`, `2048x1152`, `1152x2048`), 4K presets (`2880x2880`, `3264x2448`, `2448x3264`, `3840x2160`, `2160x3840`), as well as any custom size; the default model and `:reverse` are billed per image, while the size and quality of `:official` affect Token usage and are billed based on actual usage. Size limits: custom sizes must be multiples of 16, the longer side must not exceed 3840, the total pixel count must be 655,360–8,294,400, and the aspect ratio must not exceed 3:1. `dall-e-2` supports: `256x256`, `512x512`, `1024x1024`. `dall-e-3` supports: `1024x1024`, `1792x1024`, `1024x1792`. When `auto` is explicitly passed, the platform will determine in a continuous aspect-ratio space in order based on explicit pixels or ratios, named standards (paper / print materials / platform placements / advertisements / devices / photography / film), medium conventions, and composition. In addition to common ratios, non-preset ratios such as `1.91:1`, `1.85:1`, `2.39:1`, and ISO paper `1:√2` can also be retained; the result will be normalized to multiples of 16 and the pixel budget supported by the service. When automatic determination is unavailable, it falls back to the model's default canvas. Omitting the `size` field directly uses the model's default canvas. If there are strict pixel requirements, please directly pass `WIDTHxHEIGHT`. Static image generation and editing in GPT Image 2.6 support the above 4K pixel presets; please pass specific pixels such as `size: "3840x2160"`, and do not use `4K` as a size value. When GIF omits size or passes auto, it uses the `512x512` preview preset; it is recommended to use `size: "512x512"`, `frame_count: 9`, `frame_duration_ms: 200`. GIF size and frame count have independent limits and cannot directly use static 4K specifications; some models may adjust the actual GIF size.

quality.description: Image quality. GPT Image models support `auto` (default), `low`, `medium`, `high`; `gpt-image-2.5-flare`, `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, `gpt-image-2.6-flare`, and `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` (including `:official` variants) additionally support `xhigh`, `max`. `dall-e-3` options: `hd` or `standard`. `dall-e-2` only supports: `standard`. Official channels are billed based on actual Token usage.

n.description: The number of images to generate, ranging from 1 to 10. `dall-e-3` is fixed at `1`. The `dall-e-2`, `gpt-image-1` / `gpt-image-1.5` / `gpt-image-2` / `gpt-image-2.5-flare` / `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` series, as well as the `nano-banana` / `nano-banana-2-lite` / `nano-banana-2` / `nano-banana-2.1` / `nano-banana-pro` series all support `n>1`: the default model and `:reverse` are billed by the number of successfully generated images, while `:official` is charged based on the actual Token usage aggregated across the entire response, and will not be multiplied repeatedly by `n`. Note that `response_format=b64_json` only supports `n=1`; when `n>1`, please use the default URL return. If some images fail to generate, only the successfully generated ones will be returned and billed.
